business_summary: Apple Inc. (Nasdaq: AAPL) is the consumer-electronics and services company. Its one sourced role on this chain is funding-and-settlement-rails: Apple Pay is offered as a deposit method on Kalshi and Polymarket, functioning as a front end for an underlying debit-card transaction rather than a bespoke prediction-market product.

exposure_summary.narrative: Apple holds one sourced role on prediction-market-plumbing: funding-and-settlement-rails (EMERGING, chain position 5), a thin, substitutable payment-rail role rather than a core business line: Apple Pay sits alongside four other funding methods on the venues that offer it, and the deposit fee sits with the user, not the venue. FY2025 revenue was USD 416,161.0M (1.8% three-year CAGR) with a 32.0% operating margin, near-breakeven cash conversion (operating cash flow USD 111,482.0M against net income USD 112,010.0M), and clean quality scores (Piotroski 9/9 STRONG, Beneish -2.295 CLEAN).
